method: static field crosswalk against current production_evidence, feature_replay, entry_decision_store, historical_outcome_store, lbank_signal_outcome, decision provenance, and trade-plan paths

lifecycle_id.evidence: production replay context and entry decision packet

observed_at.evidence: production evidence and outcome observation timestamps

evidence_as_of.evidence: source capture timestamps and freshness ages; requires normalized export

score_v2_strict.evidence: ScoreV2 result merged into production metrics when strict packet exists

score_v2_watch.evidence: watch score path and unavailable component metadata

components.evidence: entry component points and ScoreV2 component result

gates.evidence: decision block reasons and strict gate result

trade_plan.evidence: canonical packet and technical feasibility shadow

availability.evidence: explicit unavailable reasons in evidence packets

acquisition_path.evidence: WS/REST source capture counters and provider attempts

outcome_horizon.evidence: lbank outcome horizon and expected/observed candles

gross_r.evidence: realized/gross fields exist; recomputation must bind entry/exit and position geometry

fees.evidence: historical execution costs can exist, but canonical forward outcome path does not guarantee a complete fee packet

slippage.evidence: entry/exit slippage fields and execution suitability inputs; completeness must be validated per outcome

funding.evidence: funding is an input to derivatives/trade plan but not guaranteed as realized per-signal outcome cost

net_r.evidence: historical rows include modeled net_realized_r but baseline integrity reports no promotion-grade cost-adjusted net-R

outcome_status.evidence: lbank outcome status vocabulary and historical outcome field

provenance.evidence: source captures, contract hashes, replay hashes, and outcome source fields

blocking_gaps: complete realized fee/slippage/funding packet per forward signal
single normalized export joining canonical signal, replay context, and outcome
non-zero natural signal/outcome denominator at the current baseline
protected study protocol and final holdout
safe_next_mechanism: research compiler/export from existing append-only evidence and outcome tables; do not add a production schema until the normalized join is proven insufficient
